name: core_demo_ops_passwords
description: Ops core plan section 10 part 1: demo_ops_passwords through the network routes, captured before any ops-core edit.

scenario.scenario_brief: Ops demo: passwords. A box of old password records has turned up in the confidential-waste bin at Merrin & Sallow. Ama Owusu of Fenlow Managed IT hosts. Staff habits give you what you need: Delphine posts about her life on the office feed and keeps a photo on her desk, Graham reuses one password everywhere, Julian picks long random ones. Crack what will crack, sign in with it, and see what an administrator can reach on the partner's PC that an ordinary user cannot. Authorised practice in a fictional office; nothing to break for real.
scenario.endGoal: Demo only: see which stored passwords fall to guessing, which never do, and what an administrator's sign-in opens.

objects.name: Things to try
objects.text:
Morning:
- Read what Delphine posts on the office feed in the kitchen.
- Take the photo from her desk while she is away.
Midday:
- Look round the kitchen, the IT room and the partner's office, then ask Ama to send them to lunch.
- Take the stored records from the bin in the IT room.
- Crack them: one will, one will after a wait, one never will.
- Sign in at Delphine's PC, then try the stick in her desk port.
- Sign in at the partner's PC as Graham, an administrator, and open the client files.
- Still signed in there, try the keystroke device in the socket beside the PC.
- Tell Ama what you find as you go.
Evening:
- Call it a day, then read the sign-in log in the IT room.

voice.name: Autonoe
voice.style: Security lead at Fenlow Managed IT, the firm that looks after Merrin & Sallow's computers, in her 40s, warm and practical. Speak with a consistent London and southern English accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent.

eventMappings.bark: Morning! Come and find me when you're ready.
Delphine's posted on the office feed. Have a read.
Lunch. Graham's off to the kitchen, and Julian's gone to his client lunch.
His PC blocks devices, but an administrator's session let it through. That window's the office network. Close it for today.

voice.name: Despina
voice.style: Merrin & Sallow's front-of-house coordinator, in her 30s, poised and polite, a little chatty. Speak with a consistent southern English accent with a light Mediterranean lilt throughout — do not shift to any other accent.
